title: Sync to live: a preview after a forward sync lists what Tracy changed per kind; apply writes only places the live site still holds as the base (compare-and-set), keeps a customer's edit as a conflict, maps new records through the id map, and a forward sync after it adds no duplicate; undo puts the live site back where nothing moved since; phase 2: files the engine writes (Joomla images/ and media/templates/, a WordPress Media Library picture) by their bytes, PHP files only linted and with their own OK, settings through site.identity, template styles, T4 site profiles, WordPress options, theme mods and Additional CSS, and everything else named with why
